seoTitle: Reach, Frequency and GRP Calculator for Ad Campaigns
metaDescription: Estimate average frequency, reach percentage and gross rating points from impressions, unique reach and population. Free and private.
intro: Enter impressions, unique reach and population to get average frequency, reach % and GRPs.
why:
Average frequency is impressions per person reached, reach is the share of the population seen, and GRPs are impressions over population times 100, which equals reach % times frequency.

Frequency is an average, so some people see the ad once and a few see it many times. Reach from different platforms cannot be added because of overlap.
howTo: Enter total impressions and unique reach.
Add spend for cost per GRP and CPM.

faq.a: Gross rating point: one percent of the target population reached, counting repeats.
The same person may appear on several platforms.
